title: Store the selected id, not the object

slides.text: Store the ID, not a copy 🆔
slides.say: A menu lets you pick a snack. Where do you keep the selection?
Storing the selected item duplicates an object that is already in items. Edit that item’s title, and the selection still shows the old one.
Keep only the selected ID. Then find the item during render. Now edits show up everywhere at once.

slides.text: Only the id is essential. The rest is calculated.
slides.say: Takeaway: the ID is the essential part. Everything else can be calculated.
